default_views.description: Views on by default for a fresh install. Comma-separated view ids from src/lib/nav.ts. Christo's own prefs still override this — it decides what a new device sees, not what he sees.

gemini_model.description: Model the Functions use. Closes a trap that has bitten twice: gemini-2.5-* now returns 'no longer available to new users' and that family shuts down October 2026. No redeploy needed. Verified: gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite.

kill_switches.description: Comma-separated feature ids to hide. The 22:00 escape hatch for a widget that is throwing. Can hide a widget; can never change alarm behaviour or any staleness guard.

notice.description: One line the whole household sees at the top of Home. Empty shows nothing.
